name: Organic Chemistry II: Aromatic & Carbonyl Chemistry
summary: Conjugated and aromatic systems, carbonyl and enolate chemistry, amines and an introduction to biomolecules.

topics.name: Conjugated dienes, allylic systems and the Diels-Alder reaction
Aromaticity, Hückel's rule and benzene stability
Electrophilic aromatic substitution and substituent effects
Aldehydes and ketones: nucleophilic addition (hydrates, acetals, imines, Wittig)
Carboxylic acids and derivatives: nucleophilic acyl substitution
Enols and enolates: α-halogenation and alkylation
Aldol, Claisen, Michael and Robinson annulation reactions
Amines: basicity, synthesis and diazonium chemistry
Carbohydrates, amino acids, lipids and nucleic acids from an organic perspective
Introduction to synthetic polymers and heterocycles
